title: Unknown country/service returns DENY, not default UK/US allow.
evidence: An unknown country gives no deadline and never an allow (test_country_deadline.py). Nothing else consults packs, so there is no resolver to deny anything.

title: Browser locale, VPN geoIP and client-submitted country never override verified contract/site/cell.
evidence: A customer's country is set only by Zoiko support, never by the browser or the client (test_country_deadline.py). No test sends a locale or address.

title: Country and subnational conflicts resolve to the stricter eligible authorization.
evidence: For the deadline, the strictest signed pack wins (test_country_deadline.py). Subnational rules are not modelled.

title: Missing licensing/legal entity blocks regulated service regardless of approved billing.
evidence: No licensing or legal-entity check exists; the pack only records an evidence status.

title: Provider license expired or scoped to wrong subregion blocks clinical handoff.
evidence: Provider licences are not modelled.

title: Unapproved clinical AI remains disabled despite underlying model endpoint being deployed.
evidence: A pack cannot switch on clinical AI, and AI is built switched off (test_packs.py, test_ai.py). There is no deployed model endpoint to test against.

title: Employer payment alone cannot enable clinician or employee-record viewing.
evidence: test_prohibitions.py: the employer role is barred from patient records whatever else is true; there is no employer payment to test.

title: Unsigned/tampered manifest rejected by cell.
evidence: A pack's content has a fingerprint and approvals bind it (test_packs.py). There are no cells and no signatures, so nothing is rejected by a cell.

title: Manifest with expired dates or wrong cell mapping rejected.
evidence: An expired pack gives nothing (test_packs.py, test_country_deadline.py). There is no cell mapping.

title: Forged or replayed approval signature cannot activate a revision.
evidence: Approvals are rows in our own database, not signatures, so there is nothing to forge or replay.

title: Unknown fields and incompatible schema versions are rejected.
evidence: Unknown fields are refused (test_packs.py). Schema versions are not modelled.

title: Author cannot self-approve mandatory Legal/DPO/CSO/CISO approvals.
evidence: test_packs.py: the author cannot approve their own pack, and two different people must approve (support and safety officers stand in for the named roles).

title: A material change invalidates affected signatures and produces a new immutable revision.
evidence: test_packs.py: sending a pack back clears its approvals, only a draft can change, and a suspended pack returns only as a new revision.

title: Preflight executes without mutating live production state.
evidence: There is no preflight.

title: G3 production enable cannot occur with any required gate PENDING/UNKNOWN.
evidence: test_readiness.py: a release stays 'not ready' while any requirement is missing. This records a decision and blocks nothing.

title: Concurrent activations and conflicting revisions cannot both become effective.
evidence: There is no activation, so no concurrent activation.

title: Revocation reaches policy cache within verified bound; stale cache cannot newly authorize.
evidence: A suspended pack stops giving new deadlines at once (test_country_deadline.py). There is no cache to bound.

title: Loss of global control plane does not create new entitlements.
evidence: There is no global control plane separate from the cell.

title: Rollback cannot restore a now-prohibited configuration.
evidence: A suspended pack comes back only as a new draft revision, never by rolling back (test_packs.py).

title: In-flight clinical cases are preserved with assigned local continuation on suspension.
evidence: A deadline already given to a request stands when its pack is suspended (test_country_deadline.py). No clinical cases are involved.

title: Transport delivery never substitutes for clinical acknowledgment.
evidence: test_orchestration.py: a delivery or a read receipt is refused as evidence of any clinical step.

title: Any unapproved cross-cell payload movement is rejected and locally audited.
evidence: There is one cell, so no cross-cell movement to reject.

title: Source and receiving jurisdictions each independently approve authorized transfers.
evidence: No cross-jurisdiction transfers.

title: Global registry and notifications never contain PHI, person IDs or small-cohort leakage.
evidence: Packs hold settings only, and webhook and partner messages carry references only (test_webhooks.py, test_partner_events.py). There is no global registry or notification service.

title: Unauthorized support impersonation and global superuser access rejected.
evidence: Support is barred from patient data and messages (test_prohibitions.py). Impersonation is not a feature, so it is not tested.

title: Restricted country pack cannot access connector in another market.
evidence: No markets or connectors to separate.

title: Missing partner contract or disabled gateway blocks service with correct user notice.
evidence: No partner contract model.

title: Expired evidence triggers alert ahead of deadline and suspension at required point.
evidence: An expired pack shows as expired and stops counting (test_packs.py). Nothing alerts ahead of the deadline.

title: Locally authorized emergency disable succeeds without unsafe clinical case loss.
evidence: Either a support or a safety officer may suspend a pack with a reason (test_packs.py). No clinical cases are involved.

title: Provider/tenant offboarding prevents new care, preserves required lawful records/rights.
evidence: No offboarding workflow.

title: Patient rights requests route to correct controlling entity and cell.
evidence: A data request goes to the patient's own clinic (test_rights.py). There are no other controlling entities or cells.

title: Regional restore replays same signed policy and cannot revert to obsolete permissions.
evidence: No regional restore.

title: Country support and accessibility/language obligations verified for approved journey.
evidence: The accessibility scan passes on every page of the four apps (browser robot 10). There is no language support.

title: Market claims in UI/marketing API cannot exceed approved capability set.
evidence: No marketing or capability-claim check.

title: Local operator access is confined to approved cell, scope, purpose and ticket duration.
evidence: Staff are confined to their own customer by row-level security and to their own organization by the rules (test_policy.py). There is no purpose or ticket duration.

title: Legal/clinical/security/privacy veto overrides executive/commercial approval.
evidence: test_readiness.py: any veto blocks the decision whatever else is signed; no commercial approval exists to override it.
